title: geniostoma helleri
intro: Geniostoma helleri, commonly known as the Heller's geniostoma or Hawaiian bee flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is a small shrub that is native to Hawaii and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Geniostoma helleri include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, such as wounds and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antiproliferative activities.
